description:
Title: Work and Live in Austria

Please check the requirements for working and living in austria.
Create a process that assists you for a combination of the steps.

Include:
* Organizing accomodation and bank account (negotiation)
* Visa (every x amount of months) - Rot-Weiss-Rot Card  

Requirements  
General principles and requirements for the issue of Visas:  
* visa application form 
* a travel document valid in Austria, with a validity period exceeding the duration of the visa by at least three months and with at least two empty pages, that was issued within the last ten years 
* a passport photo (portrait format, 35 x 45 mm) in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria 
* presentation of an fully comprehensive travel health insurance policy for the planned duration of the stay (amount of cover: 30.000 Euro, valid for the entire Schengen area) 
* proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the duration of the intended stay and for the return journey to the country of origin or residence 
* other evidence requested by the relevant authorities (hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket, proof of gainful employment etc.) - as these are adapted to local standards and coordinated with other Schengen representations, the evidence to be provided may vary depending on location 
* absence of other grounds for refusal (residence prohibition, alert issued by a Schengen country)  

Depending on the circumstances, additional documents may be requested.
Please contact the representation in advance for more information.

Generally speaking, all visa types are issued by representation offices (→ BMEIA) abroad or, in specific exceptional cases, by certain border control posts or, where extension of the visa is permitted, by the state police headquarters.

Schengen visas must be issued by the representation office of the country in which the main travel destination of the visa applicant is located.
If the applicant intends to spend an equal amount of time in several countries (for example, when touring), the competent representation office is that of the country in whose territory the main travel destination is located, on the basis of the length and purpose of the stay.
If it is not possible to determine a main travel destination, the member country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible for issuing the visa.

Territorial competence for applications for category A and C visas falls to the representation office in the consular district where the legal place of residence of the applicant is located.
A representation office may claim exceptional competence for applications from third‑country nationals legally residing but not registered in their district if the applicant can provide justification as to why they had to submit their application to that particular consulate.

Type D visas, however, must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation.
The provisions of Section 8 of the FPG apply to type D visas.
In accordance with these provisions, the territorial competence for carrying out official actions in relation to visas is determined on the basis of the foreign national's the place of residence (i.e. their centre of interest, verifiable by means of e.g. registration forms, residence permit, visa).

A list of all representation offices (addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours, special requirements for issuing visas etc.) can be found on the website of the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AdditionalDocumentRequest" name="Request for additional documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AdditionalDocuments" name="Additional documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaDecision" name="Visa decision"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkLiveAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Competent visa representation or issuing authority"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Submit visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DocumentRequest" name="Request additional documents" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDocumentRequest" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocumentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalDocuments" name="Submit additional documents" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_VisaDecision" name="Send visa decision" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>This process combines accommodation and bank-account negotiation with the visa application steps. The interval is stated as x months but its exact value is unspecified; the recurring timer is represented symbolically. The Rot-Weiss-Rot Card is included as a separate requirements check and is not assumed to be the same as a visa.</bpmn:documentation>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Planning" name="Plan work and stay in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ArrangementsSplit" name="Organize accommodation and bank account"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ArrangementsJoin" name="Accommodation and bank-account negotiations complete"/>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RecurringVisa" name="Visa process due every x months">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDef_RecurringVisa">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/PxM</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaEntryMerge" name="Continue with visa process"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCardRequirements" name="Check Rot-Weiss-Rot Card requirements">
      <bpmn:documentation>The description names the Rot-Weiss-Rot Card but does not specify its requirements. Check them without treating the card as equivalent to a visa.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FindRepresentation" name="Find representation-office details on the BMEIA website"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact representation in advance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Ask the representation for more information, including local requirements and whether additional documents may be needed.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckVisaRequirements" name="Check visa application requirements"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaCategory" name="Determine territorial competence by visa type"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineACCompetence" name="Determine competent representation for category A or C">
      <bpmn:documentation>Territorial competence is the representation office in the consular district of the applicant's legal place of residence. The responsible Schengen country is the country of the main travel destination. If equal time is planned in several countries, determine the main destination from the length and purpose of the stay; if no main destination can be determined, use the country of first entry into the Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DistrictRegistration" name="Is the applicant legally resident but not registered in that consular district?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" name="Justify application to that consulate">
      <bpmn:documentation>A representation office may claim exceptional competence for a third-country national legally residing but not registered in its district if the applicant can justify why the application had to be submitted to that consulate.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DistrictMerge" name="Continue category A or C competence check"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineDCompetence" name="Determine competent Austrian representation for type D">
      <bpmn:documentation>Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation. Section 8 of the FPG applies. Territorial competence is based on place of residence, meaning the centre of interest, verifiable for example by registration forms, a residence permit or a visa.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CategoryMerge" name="Continue with competent representation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectIssuingAuthority" name="Identify the issuing authority">
      <bpmn:documentation>Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad. In specific exceptional cases, certain border control posts may issue them or, where visa extension is permitted, state police headquarters may be involved.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" name="Prepare visa application requirements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteForm" name="Complete visa application form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Prepare qualifying travel document">
      <bpmn:documentation>The document must be valid in Austria, remain valid at least three months beyond the visa duration, have at least two empty pages, and have been issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePhoto" name="Prepare passport photo">
      <bpmn:documentation>Portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareInsurance" name="Prepare travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Fully comprehensive cover for the planned duration of stay, at least EUR 30,000, valid throughout the Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Prove sufficient means of subsistence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide proof of sufficient means for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectOtherEvidence" name="Collect other requested evidence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Evidence may include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. The evidence required may vary by location.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocumentsJoin" name="Application requirements prepared"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for other grounds for refusal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check for a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" name="Are grounds for refusal present?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RefusalGround" name="Visa application cannot proceed due to refusal ground"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" name="Are additional documents requested?"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDocumentRequest" name="Receive request for additional documents" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocumentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" name="Prepare additional requested documents"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments" name="Submit additional documents"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive visa decision" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Was the visa issued?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaIssued" name="Visa issued"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaRefused" name="Visa refused"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanningToSplit" sourceRef="Start_Planning" targetRef="Gateway_ArrangementsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToAccommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrangementsSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccommodationToJoin" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_ArrangementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToBank" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrangementsSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankToJoin" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_ArrangementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrangementsToVisaMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrangementsJoin" targetRef="Gateway_VisaEntryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerToVisaMerge" sourceRef="Start_RecurringVisa" targetRef="Gateway_VisaEntryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaMergeToCardCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaEntryMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckCardRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CardCheckToFindRepresentation" sourceRef="Task_CheckCardRequirements" targetRef="Task_FindRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FindRepresentationToContact" sourceRef="Task_FindRepresentation" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactToVisaRequirements" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Task_CheckVisaRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaRequirementsToCategory" sourceRef="Task_CheckVisaRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_VisaCategory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CategoryToAC" name="Category A or C" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_DetermineACCompetence">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">category = 'A' or category = 'C'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CategoryToD" name="Type D" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_DetermineDCompetence">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">category = 'D'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ACToDistrict" sourceRef="Task_DetermineACCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_DistrictRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistrictNeedsJustification" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_DistrictRegistration" targetRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">legallyResident and not registeredInDistrict</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistrictNoJustification" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_DistrictRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_DistrictMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not (legallyResident and not registeredInDistrict)</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JustificationToDistrictMerge" sourceRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_DistrictMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistrictToCategoryMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_DistrictMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CategoryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DToCategoryMerge" sourceRef="Task_DetermineDCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_CategoryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CategoryMergeToAuthority" sourceRef="Gateway_CategoryMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectIssuingAuthority"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AuthorityToDocumentsSplit" sourceRef="Task_SelectIssuingAuthority" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToForm" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FormToDocumentsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompleteForm" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToTravelDocument" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelDocumentToDocumentsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToPhoto" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhotoToDocumentsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PreparePhoto" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToInsurance" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceToDocumentsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToMeans" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MeansToDocumentsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToOtherEvidence" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_CollectOtherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherEvidenceToDocumentsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CollectOtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsJoinToGroundsCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GroundsCheckToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GroundsPresent" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="End_RefusalGround">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">residenceProhibition or schengenAlert</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGrounds" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not residenceProhibition and not schengenAlert</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToAdditionalDocumentsGateway" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocumentsRequested" name="Yes, additional documents are requested" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDocumentRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">additionalDocumentsRequested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalDocuments" name="No additional documents are requested" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not additionalDocumentsRequested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToPrepare" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDocumentRequest" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareToSubmitAdditional" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitAdditionalToDecision" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionToGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaIssued" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="End_VisaIssued">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">visaIssued</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaRefused" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="End_VisaRefused">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not visaIssued</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
